title: custom:energy-flow-card-pro
description: Where the energy came from and where it went over a period (today, yesterday, this week, month or year): solar, battery and grid → home → rooms and devices, from energy meters and their long-term statistics.

iconSize.description: Diameter of the node's circle (px); the icon follows. Defaults: solar and grid 44, battery 40, home 46, consumer and room 32, a room's device 24; a list row's at most 36

secondary.description: A line under the name. Template allowed.

color.description: Fixed colour of the node; overrides the flow colour and the rules

rules.description: On the meter's energy in the period (kWh): colour and icon of the node; first match wins

entity.description: Production: an energy meter (kWh, Wh, MWh …) with long-term statistics

charge.description: Energy into the battery: an energy meter

discharge.description: Energy out of the battery: an energy meter

soc.description: State of charge in %: the ring of the node (now)

charge_from.description: `solar`: only the panels charge this battery, never the grid. The entity of a solar source (or a list of them) instead: only those panels charge it.

import.description: Energy from the grid: an energy meter

export.description: Energy returned to the grid: an energy meter

hide_below.description: This consumer's own hide_consumers_below (kWh); 0 never hides it
hide_consumers_below for the room's devices (kWh); a device's own wins

period.description: The period the card shows: calendar-aligned in Home Assistant's time zone, the week from Monday; it turns over by itself. dashboard: the period of Home Assistant's energy date picker on the dashboard (today without one); the card then has no picker of its own

collection_key.description: With period: dashboard, the energy date picker to follow: its collection_key (Home Assistant's own option), e.g. energy_living_room. Default: the dashboard's

period_picker.description: A picker in the header: the viewer steps to another day, week, month or year (‹ ›) and switches between them; it goes back to `period` after 10 minutes untouched. false: a fixed period

sources.description: The sources, in drawing order: solar arrays, batteries and grid connections, each with its energy meters

home.description: The home's consumption: an energy meter, or an object with `name`, `icon`, `rules` (and `entity`). Without an entity the home is computed from the sources

consumers.description: Devices, or rooms with devices, to the right of the home

name.description: Its own name (default: Other, translated), e.g. Losses

other.description: An "Other" node for what the consumers do not account for (default: true when consumers are given); an object shows it with its own `name`, `icon` or `icon_size`

idle_below.description: kWh below which a link is idle (no motion); 0 lets every trickle flow

idle_links.description: Links that carry nothing: dashed tracks, hidden, or faint solid lines

decimals.description: Decimals of the values: one number for both units, or `{ kwh, mwh }` (default 1 and 2); MWh from 1000 kWh

flow_style.description: How the flow moves on a link: dots, dashes (lines) or arrows; none draws the active links in their colour without motion

hide_consumers_below.description: Hide a consumer while its energy in the period stays below this many kWh; it comes back clearly above (20 %). Its energy counts in Other. 0 never hides

rules.description: On the home's energy in the period in kWh (below / above): label pill, colour of the home node, tint; first match wins

title_tap_action.description: Action when the title or its icon is tapped, e.g. navigate to the room's dashboard (default: none)
